title: webconsulting Redaktion: overview film
description: The actual macOS app with demo content from the TYPO3 lab: pages and languages, the page assistant, the element wizard, translation, links, media and news. Narrated, with selectable English captions.
alt: Overview film, 89 seconds: webconsulting Redaktion. Pages and content in every language, a page assistant, TYPO3's element wizard, translation next to the original, TYPO3 links, a media library with alt text per use and calm news writing with local drafts. Narrated, with selectable English captions.

transcript.text: One page, four languages, a dozen images, and a deadline.
Redaktion is a calm Mac workspace for TYPO3. Your drafts stay on your Mac. TYPO3 stays in charge of publishing.
Pages look the way TYPO3 shows them. Language tabs count what is already translated.
The page assistant places a new page, sets its URL path and translations, and keeps it hidden until you publish.
Elements come from TYPO3’s own wizard, Content Blocks included, filtered by the rules of each column.
Translations use TYPO3’s own command, and the original text sits right under each field.
Link pages, their content, files and records. Links keep TYPO3’s format and show their titles.
The media library works on TYPO3’s file list, and every image gets its own alternative text where it is used.
News keeps its calm writing surface, with local drafts that survive an offline restart.
Redaktion, by webconsulting. Ask us for a demonstration.
